choice-justified:schema-explorer.why: Primary was schema-explorer with path-highlighting, details-on-demand and a provenance inspector; the existing derivation graph (render_review.py) is exactly that and was kept. port-graph is a secondary Architecture lens (router planning-review 'Default linked lenses'), not a replacement.

fixed-desktop-panel-widths.why: Inspector is 300px only above 900px; below it the grid is one column and the inspector is static.

page-level-horizontal-scroll.why: Render check at 390px measured h_scroll=false on shaping-v2, gate and whygame5 pages; wide drawings scroll inside their own box behind a disclosure on phones.

secondary-panels-dominating-primary-task.why: Decision and review points come first; drawings follow; provenance last.

no-control-overlap.why: Looked at 390px full-page and 1280px screenshots: no overlapping controls.

keyboard-reachable-controls.why: Graph nodes and port nodes have tabindex=0 and Enter/Space handlers; outline and wiring entries are links; disclosures are native details.

persistent-selection-visible.why: Selected node keeps a thick outline and the rest dims; the inspector shows the selected id.

title-states-what-this-is-and-for-whom.why: H1: 'AES plan gate, second shaping: what this plan would add to AES, for Brian to approve'.

whole-design-visible-on-one-screen-at-th.why: Not met: the page is long (about 7,000 px at 390px). The router planned a 1440px viewport even with mobile true (AES issue #127); at 390 the decision fits the first screen, the rest scrolls.

cold-reader-gets-the-mechanism-in-sixty-.why: Not tested with a cold reader; only the author has read it.

form-matches-job-lists-scan-tables-compa.why: Review points, reference check and orphan files are lists; derivation and data flow are drawings on wide screens, outline and one-line-per-function lists on phones, after judging each at 390px.

relationships-drawn-not-implied-by-adjac.why: Derivation edges and port wires are drawn; on phones nesting and 'takes X from f' state each relation explicitly.

same-object-same-mark-across-every-view.why: Same ids everywhere; file/run marks use the same colour tokens in drawing, outline and legend; port nodes select the same inspector entry as the file node.

every-object-reveals-more-on-click-nothi.why: Every derivation node, outline item, port node and wiring line opens the inspector with full text and source id.

balanced-panel-sizing.why: Drawing takes the width, inspector 300px on wide screens.

clear-primary-action.why: Decision box names the three answers and what each causes.

details-do-not-obscure-context.why: Inspector is beside (wide) or below (phone) the drawing, never over it.

first-frame-legibility.why: 390px first screen: title, what the page is, source revision, decision.

one-primary-drawing-with-callouts-not-pa.why: One derivation drawing with an inspector; the port drawing is a separate lens.

overlapping-views-merged-into-one-view-w.why: The first shaping's separate structure view and criterion table were dropped because the derivation view already carries them.

attributed-claims-traced-to-source-no-in.why: All drawing text is verbatim from target/proposal records or code signatures; inspector cites .aes/target.yaml id.

structural-devices-encode-information-no.why: Fill = file existence, outline = run status, dashed thick outline = proposed; component colour in the port graph.

no-generated-defaults-cream-serif-card-k.why: Uses the existing render_review.py style, which has cards and middle-dot separators; not restyled in this shaping.

each-concept-drawn-in-a-shape-that-mirro.why: Functions as boxes with typed input ports on top and output port below; derivation as left-to-right layers.

white-space-separates-groups-and-carries.why: Sections separated by headings and spacing.

size-and-weight-follow-importance.why: Decision first with accent border; provenance small and last.

structure-earned-by-content-not-imposed-.why: Six layers are the target's own families.

space-and-time-shown-together-when-the-s.why: The subject is one revision; no time dimension. The router's time-strip secondary was not built for that reason.

page-carries-its-date-and-version.why: Source line shows repository revision and build time.

a-person-would-pin-it-on-a-wall.why: Not judged; it is a working review page, not a poster.

each-element-encodes-its-answer-visually.why: Marks are visual (fill/outline) with words beside them for colour-blind reading.

each-drawing-shows-relations-a-list-cann.why: Judged per view at 390 and 1280: drawings kept on wide screens for fan-in/fan-out; replaced by lists on phones where they did not beat a list.

gap-between-groups-larger-than-gap-withi.why: Section margins larger than card gaps.

enclosure-nesting-at-most-two-levels.why: Cards inside sections only; the phone outline nests lists, not boxes.

elements-share-a-small-set-of-edges.why: Single column on phone; two-column grid on wide.

same-role-same-treatment-everywhere.why: Same mark tokens in every lens.

context-quiet-subject-loud.why: Existing context chains are thin-outlined; proposed entries bold/thick dashed.

comparisons-use-identical-small-frames.why: No side-by-side comparisons on the page.

every-encoding-explained-on-the-same-scr.why: Legend sits directly above each drawing.

object-count-within-density-budget-or-ag.why: Proposal mode limits to touched entries and their chains (about 40 nodes); untouched functions are listed, not drawn.

no-block-of-prose-longer-than-the-drawin.why: Legends are 3 to 5 lines above drawings.

reader-can-point-to-where-any-one-fact-l.why: Every fact carries its record id and the source file.
